messages:
Alex Chen: Heads-up — prepping the QBR show-and-tell for Crestline tomorrow. Need final slides + 1-line exec bullets by EOD. Putting checklist here: https://tiny.redwood/qbr-checklist. Who can own onboarding/status + renewal risk?

Marta Ruiz: I can own the onboarding/status slide. Will include last 30d activation, time-to-first-success, and open blockers. @Samir — can you confirm renewal signal + NRR for the account?

Samir Patel: Sending NRR in a moment. Also flagging a renewal risk due to two integration fail tickets (INTG-412, INTG-419) — adding to the heatmap. Uploading remediation notes now.

OpsBot: File uploaded: crestline_onboarding_30d.xlsx (2 MB) — https://drive.redwood/crestline_onboarding_30d.xlsx

Lucy Chen: I'll take demo cue cards and run the 10-min dry run at 10:30am tomorrow. Need the feature-matrix slide + final deck by 5pm so I can rehearse.

Theo (CSE): Quick note — execs want concise asks. I'll draft 1-line exec asks (max 3 bullets) for the top slides and add a fallback recommendation for Dedicated vs Hosted routing.

Alex Chen: Action items: Marta — onboarding slide (owner); Samir — renewal heatmap + NRR snippet; Lucy — demo cards + run; Theo — exec asks. I'll do final compile + visual polish. Please update this thread when your slide is uploaded. :thumbsup:

Marta Ruiz: Quick Q — for onboarding metrics do we present 'activated users' or 'engaged seats'? We changed the definition last month and want consistency.

Alex Chen: Use 'activated users' for the main slide (simpler for execs). Add 'engaged seats' to the appendix with the new def and a short note on metric change.

Samir Patel: NRR snippet: 98.7% last quarter. Added note: two integration regressions delayed onboarding in 3 accounts — remediation plan attached (owners: infra-team + integrations). Uploaded heatmap as crestline_renewal_heatmap.png.

Lucy Chen: Demo artifacts and runbook uploaded to Figma + shared drive: https://figma.redwood/crestline-demo and https://drive.redwood/crestline_demo_runbook.md

Lucy Chen: Small demo checklist (paste for reference):
```
1) login as demo_user@crestline
2) run sample prompt (policy-check)
3) validate response + latency < 350ms
4) toggle fallback to smaller model to show graceful degradation
```

Theo (CSE): Exec asks added to each slide. Kept them to 1 line each — ask examples: 'Approve extended pilot budget', 'Sign-off on Dedicated capacity for peak periods', 'Greenlight engineering support for integration fixes'. Uploaded deck v3 (filename: crestline_qbr_v3.pptx).

Alex Chen: Thanks — last call: react with :white_check_mark: after you upload so I know we're green. I'll compile at 18:15 and send to the exec thread at 19:00.

Marta Ruiz: :white_check_mark: uploaded onboarding slide (crestline_onboarding_30d.xlsx -> slide 4)

Samir Patel: :white_check_mark: uploaded heatmap + NRR snippet (crestline_renewal_heatmap.png)

Lucy Chen: :white_check_mark: demo cards + runbook uploaded

Theo (CSE): :white_check_mark: exec asks + deck v3 uploaded

Alex Chen: Awesome — I'll post final deck and run order to the exec channel 7pm. Thanks team!
